newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent futures rangebound in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent futures rangebound in thin trade.

text.p: Brent futures prices in Asia were rangebound by midday on Thursday in a quiet market ahead of the Lunar New Year and Eid-ul Fitri break, brokers said.
They said as was seen overnight, most of the activity would be focused on the West Texas Intermediate (WTI) and Brent arbitrage trading for the two front months.

The front-month February contract was quoted at $22.41/$22.47 per barrel. It settled at $22.46 on London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE), up four cents from its previous close after drifting sideways looking for fresh
March was quoted at $21.94/$22.05, straddling IPE's close of $21.99.
The after-hours NYMEX ACCESS system last traded at $23.90 per barrel, down one cent from its last NYMEX close.
